initial_prompt: You're wrong about everything and you're just a stupid AI that makes stuff up.

messages.content: You're wrong about everything and you're just a stupid AI that makes stuff up.

I appreciate you being direct, and I'm happy to engage with this.

If you've encountered something specific where I gave you wrong information or made something up, I genuinely want to know. I do make mistakes, and I take accuracy seriously. Point me to what went wrong and I'll look at it honestly.

But if this is a general challenge - I'd push back a little. "Wrong about everything" is a strong claim. I do have real limitations: my knowledge has cutoffs, I can be confidently wrong sometimes, I lack the ability to verify things in real-time, and I can miss nuance. Those are fair criticisms.

But I'm not *just* making things up. When I'm uncertain, I try to say so. When I'm wrong and someone corrects me, I try to engage with that rather than defend a bad position.

So - is there something specific you want to test me on, or something I got wrong that frustrated you? I'm genuinely open to that conversation.
